title: Learning Graph Viewer
description: An interactive vis.js network graph viewer for exploring geometry concepts and their dependencies with search, filtering, and statistics.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mathematics
Geometry
Education
Learning Graph
learningObjectives: Identify the taxonomy categories of the geometry learning graph using the color-coded legend
Trace prerequisite dependencies between geometry concepts by following the directed edges of the network
Locate a specific geometry concept with the type-ahead search and inspect its prerequisite connections
Evaluate the graph's structure using the node, edge, and orphan statistics as category filters are toggled
Design a study sequence by filtering categories so foundational concepts are covered before dependent ones
